notes.title: Update 0.16
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We've just released Update 0.16, which introduces targeted gameplay improvements based on your feedback.
Good news: this update is fully compatible with your save files from version 0.15. There is no need to start a new game.

[b]What's new in version 0.16:[/b]
Improved Shooting Mechanics: We've made adjustments to weapon handling and feedback to make combat feel more comfortable and dynamic.
Fixes & Stability: A variety of minor bugs have been squashed to improve overall game performance and stability.
Thank you for playing and helping us make the game better!

notes.title: Update 0.15
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce the release of Update 0.15. This patch marks a major milestone in the game's development and introduces colossal changes aimed at improving gameplay, narrative, and technical performance.

[b]IMPORTANT INFORMATION: A NEW GAME IS REQUIRED[/b]

We must emphasize that to ensure the update functions correctly, all players must start a new game.

Due to fundamental changes in the quest architecture, old save files are completely incompatible with the new version. Attempting to load an old save will lead to critical bugs, broken quests, and overall game instability. We understand this may be an inconvenience, but it is a necessary step to ensure the integrity of your gameplay experience.

Key Changes in Update 0.15:

Complete Questline Overhaul: The main focus of this update. The entire storyline has been systematically rebuilt to improve the narrative, logic, and player engagement. This includes altered dialogues, new objectives, and different outcomes.

New Quests: To complement the reworked system, we have added a series of brand-new quests designed to enrich the world and offer new challenges.

Redesigned User Interface (UI): The game's interface has been completely redesigned from the ground up. It now features a cleaner design, intuitive navigation, and a modern look.
Optimization and Performance: We have implemented significant improvements that will provide a smoother and more stable gameplay experience across a wide range of hardware.

Numerous Bug Fixes: This patch also includes a comprehensive list of fixes for bugs reported by the community and discovered during internal testing.

We sincerely thank our community for its patience and continued support. We believe these changes have made the game significantly better and look forward to hearing your feedback!

notes.title: Update 0.13
notes.content:
Improved Camera Visibility Through Player Model:

Fixed an issue where your character model could obstruct the camera's view, especially in tight spaces or when the camera moved close to the model. Visibility through' or 'around' the character in such situations is now significantly improved (e.g., the model might become semi-transparent, or the camera will navigate more intelligently around the obstruction).

notes.title: update 0.12
notes.content:
We're continuously working to enhance your experience and are pleased to present another update! This time, we've focused on First-Person Camera, refining the user interface, and enhancing the tutorial and pause features for your convenience.

[b]First-Person Camera Position Adjustment[/b]:
What is it? We've adjusted the first-person camera position to provide improved visibility.

[b]User Interface (UI) Enhancements[/b]:
What is it? We've made some refinements to the user interface to make it even more convenient and intuitive to use.

[b]Improved Tutorial[/b]:
What is it? For new users and those who want to refresh their knowledge, we've enhanced and expanded the interactive tutorial.

[b]Pause Functionality[/b]:
What is it? You can now pause the gameplay at any moment.

We hope these improvements make using our game even more enjoyable! We look forward to your feedback!
